name: CFX: return to detent
lesson:
## The knob has a home

Turn CFX A left into low-pass over 4 bars, bring it back to the centre click over 4, rest a bar; then right into high-pass over 3 bars, back over 3, rest. The score cares most about the two returns: the knob must sit exactly on the detent, because anything else is a filter you forgot about.

Left of centre is low-pass (the track gets muffled, bass stays), right is high-pass (the track gets thin, bass goes). The FLX4 CFX has a physical notch at the middle; learn to feel it without looking. A filter left a few degrees off centre is the most common reason a "clean" mix sounds dull.
